status: Both original DDraw4 and DDraw7 now complete. Vertex-buffer factory identity/reference, descriptors, large-count retry and discard contracts pass. Overall original Wine acceptance remains incomplete.
changes: Introduce factory-specific vertex-buffer creation and retain owner allocation lifetime in both APIs. Device3/legacy buffers keep the parent privately, while Device7 buffers also hold the observable public parent reference. Symmetric creation-failure and destruction paths preserve these distinct native counts. Neither factory retains a Device object.

Legacy and v7 buffers expose only their matching buffer IID and IUnknown; IUnknown equals the factory-returned pointer. Rejected cross-version queries return E_NOINTERFACE with NULL output and no extra references. This removes the original leaked reference after a query that should have failed.

GetVertexBufferDesc returns the three payload DWORDs regardless of caller dwSize and preserves that word, including zero. Constructor multiplication overflow returns D3DERR_TOOMANYVERTICES before allocation, enabling the original timed test retry. No new 64K vertex cap; valid 65536-vertex buffers are explicitly covered.

DDLOCK_DISCARDCONTENTS invalidates processed clip state but preserves the CPU backing pointer and bytes, matching repeated-lock original tests. Existing read-only/update failure and lock-state behavior is retained.

nativeChecks.scope: The full 78-script set passed. After the final change confined to d3d7_vb_Lock, the only two tests extracting this method were rerun and their saved results/exit codes refreshed; complete original DDraw4/7 were both rerun on the final source.
